ios-forms|Token fields.summary: A Plenix people or entity picker on iOS is a search field that suggests records as people type and keeps the chosen ones as tokens: the field in the Plenix control roles (6-point corners, at least 44 points tall, the border turning the focus color), suggestions in a list with the person’s avatar (a rounded square) or the record’s icon tile, the name in DM Sans over a detail line, an ID in DM Mono, and each token a soft Plenix tag with its remove button. iOS has no token field of its own (UISearchTextField has search tokens; the Mac has NSTokenField); Plenix keeps the system field and keyboard and draws the suggestions and tokens with its roles.

variants.use: Linking a record to projects, assets or accounts.

variants.name: Multiple
